technology.subtitle: From compressed air to clean, continuous energy.
technology.intro: AirPower's patented system transforms ambient air into clean, on-demand power using a closed-loop cycle. With no fuel, no combustion, and only cold air as its byproduct, the AirPower Station redefines how energy is generated, stored, and delivered — available in 20-foot (0.5MW) and 40-foot (1.5MW) containerized platforms.

s1.title: Ambient Air Compression
s1.description: Air is drawn from the atmosphere and compressed into onboard storage tanks using an integrated compressor system. The tanks in the AirPower Station fill in just 3 minutes to power the CAE for up to 16 hours runtime per fill cycle.

s2.title: Engine Activation
s2.description: Stored compressed air powers our proprietary compressed air engine (CAE), which converts air pressure into mechanical energy.

s3.title: Power Generation
s3.description: The engine drives an integrated generator to produce on-demand electricity — powering external equipment or charging the onboard battery storage system.

s4.title: Cold Air Exhaust
s4.description: As the engine operates, it releases only cold, dry air — no combustion, no emissions. Temperatures can reach below -35°C, making it ideal for industrial cooling applications.

s5.title: Optional Battery Storage (BESS)
s5.description: Excess energy generated is stored in an integrated 1.5MW lithium or graphene battery system for continuous uptime or backup use.

s6.title: Deployment & Use
s6.description: The AirPower Station can be installed on-site, mounted on trucks, or delivered to remote locations. It's built to power everything from data centers and grow operations to disaster relief zones and off-grid microgrids.

about.subtitle: Redefining clean, reliable, and deployable power with patented compressed air technology.

mission.title: Mission Statement
mission.body: AirPower USA is on a mission to redefine clean, reliable, and deployable power. Our patented compressed air engine and generator system delivers zero-emission electricity with built-in battery storage, producing cold, clean air as a valuable byproduct. We design our systems to operate anywhere — from military bases to disaster zones — without reliance on traditional grid infrastructure.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Founded to solve one of the most pressing challenges of our time — how to provide scalable, off-grid energy that's both clean and dependable — AirPower USA combines decades of engineering innovation with practical, real-world deployment experience.
story.p2: Our technology leverages the most abundant fuel source on the planet: ambient air. By compressing and storing air, our systems can generate power on demand, recharge themselves, and recycle energy in a closed loop. This approach eliminates emissions, reduces fuel logistics, and creates operational flexibility unmatched by diesel or intermittent renewable systems.
story.p3: We operate with the belief that energy security is essential — whether that's powering a remote village, keeping mission-critical military operations online, or enabling first responders in the aftermath of a disaster.

ahead.cta: Join us as we scale our patented energy technology into a global clean energy leader — delivering true energy independence.

faqs.title: Investor FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about investing in AirPower USA's Regulation D offering.

q1.q: How do I invest in AirPower USA?
q1.a: You can invest directly through our current Regulation D offering by completing the subscription agreement and submitting your payment. Once processed, your shares will be recorded with our transfer agent. Contact us at invest@airpowerusa.net for the investor packet and instructions.

q2.a: Our current round is open to accredited investors under SEC Regulation D, Rule 506(c). You'll need to meet accreditation criteria such as income or net worth thresholds.

q3.a: We accept wire transfers and ACH payments for U.S.-based investors. International investors may also use bank wire. (Exact payment instructions are provided in your subscription packet.)

q4.q: What is the price per share?
q4.a: In Round 1, shares are offered at $3.00 per share with a $10,000 minimum investment.

q5.q: What is the minimum to invest?

q6.q: What is the maximum I can invest?
q6.a: There is no hard maximum for accredited investors under Reg D. Investments over certain thresholds may require additional compliance review.

q7.q: Can I invest in AirPower USA if I am a resident in another country?
q7.a: Yes, non-U.S. residents may invest, subject to applicable local laws and completion of required compliance documentation.

q8.q: Where can I see my shares?
q8.a: Your shares will be recorded with our appointed transfer agent, who will provide you with account access and documentation.

q9.q: Where can I find more information about AirPower USA?
q9.a: Visit airpowerusa.com or contact invest@airpowerusa.net for our executive summary, pitch deck, and Reg D investor documents.

q10.q: Is there a direct number for the AirPower USA Investor Relations Team?
q10.a: Yes — investor inquiries can be made at 214.257.7957.

q11.q: What platform(s) are AirPower USA investment opportunities available on?
q11.a: Our current offering is conducted privately under Reg D and is available directly from the company, not through public crowdfunding platforms.

q12.q: When is the last day to buy shares?
q12.a: Round 1 is open until fully subscribed. Availability is first-come, first-served.

q13.a: Valuation is based on current offering price and number of shares outstanding. Contact us for current details.

q14.q: What is the initial projected return on investment (ROI)?
q14.a: Projected ROI depends on company growth, product adoption, and potential future liquidity events such as an IPO. ROI is not guaranteed.

q15.q: Does AirPower USA plan to do an initial public offering (IPO) and if so, when?
q15.a: Yes. The company plans to be publicly listed by Q1-Q2 2026, emerging as an NYSE, AMEX, or NASDAQ trading entity.

q16.q: What happens to my shares if AirPower USA goes public?
q16.a: Private shares typically convert to publicly tradable shares after IPO, subject to any lock-up periods or transfer restrictions.

q17.a: AirPower USA is currently reinvesting all profits into growth. Dividend payments are not expected in the near term.

q18.q: What is a Transfer Agent and who is AirPower USA's Transfer Agent?
q18.a: A transfer agent maintains records of shareholder ownership. The appointed transfer agent will be disclosed in your investor documentation.

q19.a: Shares may be transferable in accordance with applicable securities laws and company bylaws. Restrictions may apply for private securities.

q20.a: An accredited investor meets income or net worth thresholds defined by the SEC (e.g., $200,000 annual income or $1 million net worth excluding primary residence).

q21.a: Regulation A is an SEC exemption that allows certain public offerings to non-accredited investors. AirPower USA is not currently using Reg A.

q22.q: Where can I find the Regulation D offering memorandum?
q22.a: Contact invest@airpowerusa.net to request the full investor packet, which includes the offering memorandum and subscription agreement.

q23.q: What is the difference between an accredited offering (Reg D) and a non-accredited offering (Reg A)?
q23.a: Reg D offerings are limited to accredited investors and allow higher investment amounts with less public disclosure. Reg A offerings can include non-accredited investors but require additional SEC qualification and public filings.
